Complexity:
License SKU Names :
1. Automotive Cloud

4. Automotive Cloud User Add-On - HF OZ

Pre-requisites:
Pre-requisites:

1. System Administrator logs in to Org having Automotive Cloud + MuleSoft Anypoint required licenses
Scenarios:
Complete the following steps to enable Appraisal Management (with Provider Valuations + ARC) :

Navigate to Setup
1. Go to Setup in Salesforce.
2. From the Quick Find box, search for and select Salesforce Go

Access Feature Settings
1. Within Salesforce Go, navigate to Features.
2. Locate and select Automotive Cloud
3. Locate and select Appraisal Management
4. Locate and select Provider Valuation
5. Locate and select ARC Relationship Graph

Complete the guided setup by performing the following:
1. Enable the ORG Preference - Automotive Cloud + Appraisal Management + Provider Valuation
2. Configure External Services for KBB, Black Book, Manheim MMR (named credentials, auth, retry policy)
3. Configure VIN Decode service (NHTSA fallback, OEM primary)
4. Assign required User PSLs

Sales Manager -
Automotive Cloud Admin
Appraisal Management Admin
Provider Valuation Admin

Sales Consultant -
Appraisal Management User

Inspector -
Appraisal Management User (mobile-enabled)

F&I Manager -
Appraisal Management User
Vehicle and Asset Lending User

5. Create record types : Product (Vehicle, Parts), Asset (Vehicle, Parts), Appraisal (Trade-In, Standalone-ICO, Lease-Return, Fleet), Opportunity (New-Vehicle, Used-Vehicle)
6. Deploy ARC graph definitions on Account, Contact, Vehicle, Asset, Appraisal
7. Configure Compliant Data Sharing for multi-rooftop
8. Configure Salesforce Scheduler for inspection appointments
9. (Optional) Configure Experience Cloud site for self-service ICO
Integration Component: KBB, Black Book, Manheim MMR, NHTSA VIN decode (via MuleSoft Anypoint)

User Journey: Appraisal Management - setup - Data (with Provider Valuations + ARC)
Business Process:
Setup an Automotive Cloud Appraisal org with multi-provider valuation and ARC

Personas Involved:
1. Salesforce System Administrator
2. Sales Manager
3. F&I Manager
Complexity:
Provider blend rule variations :
Lowest of three
Average of three
Configurable weighted blend (e.g. KBB 40%, BB 30%, MMR 30%)

ARC graph variations :
Account -> Asset -> Appraisal
Account -> Opportunity -> Appraisal -> Asset
Fleet -> Fleet Asset -> Appraisal
Pre-requisites:
Pre-requisites:

1. System Administrator logs in to Org having Appraisal Management - setup - configuration (with Provider Valuations + ARC) - done
Scenarios:
1. Create 100 Vehicle Products + 50 Parts Products + price book entries, 8 Business Brands, 20 Business Accounts, 200 Person Accounts
2. Create 4 dealer-group accounts, 12 rooftop accounts, 50 dealership users
3. Create 4 Appraisal record types and 1 Provider Blend rule per record type
4. Create 30 default condition codes per Appraisal Item category
5. Create 200 Asset records (Vehicle RT, distributed across rooftops)
6. Create 50 Financial Account records (Vehicle and Asset Lending) for lease-return scenarios
7. Create / Upload 80 Appraisal records - 20 per record type - across statuses Draft / In Review / Manager Review / Locked / Funded
8. Create 400 Appraisal Item rows
9. Create 240 Provider Valuation rows (3 providers x 80 appraisals)
10. Create 80 OEM program rules (loyalty / conquest)
11. Seed ARC graph traversal data for Account -> Asset -> Appraisal -> Opportunity -> Asset paths
Integration Component: KBB, Black Book, Manheim MMR, NHTSA VIN decode
